items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: We played with the same group -- that group that I just mentioned... Johnny Mince played the clarinet

ctx.x: Sure -- and Johnny Mince on clarinet. And he used to sell bands, I think he sold a band, Tommy Dorsey's first band was one of his organized bands, and then he'd go find some more good musicians, young talent -- he was one -- Joe Haymes was the foremost.
Uh huh. I can remember him and Cab Calloway and Chick Webb talk about this Mal Hallett band because it was a territory band.
